about.title: About Her
about.bio:
Fehintola Onabanjo na Yoruba gospel and motivational music minister wey her sound mix Yoruba folk, Highlife, Alujo and Gospel Reggae together. She start her music career for 2016 with Ara Edide, and since then she don drop four albums and plenty singles wey people dey hear everywhere for the world.

As the band leader of Favoured Music Band, Fehintola (JP) dey do live show wey get plenty energy, wey dey talk about faith, strength and African heritage. Her music dey talk to people wey don tire, people wey still get hope and people wey dey thank God — e dey remind us say we be favoured.
about.quote: Music na my ministry. Music, message and testimony everywhere — na language wey the whole world understand.
